In reality, a sunny day often sees a much larger temperature swing, frequently reaching 20-30°F or more above the morning low by 2:00 p.m. Consequently, 78°F is a much more realistic estimate than 41°F (which implies no change) or 98°F (which is too extreme for a "mild" day).
